notes:
{全員|ぜんいん} refers to every single member of a defined group. Unlike ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧, it emphasizes completeness — no one is excluded.

USAGE:
Often used with ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ as the subject ({全員|ぜんいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧) or as a noun modifier ({全員|ぜんいん}⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧). Common in announcements, reports, and formal contexts. Can be used with counters: {全員|ぜんいん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧10⟦{人|にん}→人：00658_nin⟧ (all 10 people).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全員|ぜんいん}⟦{一致|いっち}→一致：01733_icchi⟧ (unanimous agreement)
- {全員|ぜんいん}⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧ (full participation)
- {全員|ぜんいん}⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧ (everyone safe)
- {全員|ぜんいん}⟦{集合|しゅうごう}→集合：03068_shuugou⟧ (everyone gather)
- {全員|ぜんいん}⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧ (everyone passes)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧: everyone (casual, can refer to a vague group)
- ⟦{皆|みな}さん→皆さん：02971_minasan⟧: everyone (polite address)
- ⟦{全|すべ}て→全て：03822_subete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: all people (broader, not limited to a defined group)
- ⟦{一同|いちどう}→一同：08918_ichidou⟧: all present (very formal, used in speeches and letters)
